exposure: Feeding method at 6 weeks postpartum (breastfeeding, mixed feeding, artificial feeding)
cohort: 7,703 parturients who underwent postpartum health check-ups at a tertiary hospital in Urumqi, Xinjiang, between January 2018 and September 2021
finding: The incidence of postpartum depression and anxiety increased from 2018 to 2020, slightly decreased in 2021 but remained higher than in 2019, with maternal age, occupation, mode of delivery, feeding pattern, and neonatal sex identified as potential risk factors.
mod_finding: Women who delivered via cesarean section were more likely to have postpartum anxiety.
